api.check: Required callable, return ignored. Invoked for bounded-work cancellation only; every BaseException propagates unchanged by identity outside metadata-error catches. Invalid noncallable interface raises TypeError. It is not a clock or authority.
report: to_json_bytes() -> retained immutable canonical UTF8 bytes
api.scope: One pure metadata calculation. No source/stream/output/file callbacks, filesystem discovery, owner/Origin construction, runtime activation or actual roster authentication.

capture_contract.captured_metadata: Captured immutable bytes required for declared byte-consuming checker use; not importable.
capture_contract.captured_software: Captured immutable bytes required and declared importable graph member. Assembly+immutable capture counted separately.
capture_contract.hash_only_bulk: No assembly/capture bytes; contributes full size to streaming hash read reservation and full call retention. Not a loader or checker-byte source. This classifies metadata only; existing V3 runtime still requires capture=True and does not implement this path.
invariants: No extension or size heuristic changes role.
Every file contributes to query witnesses and canonical call retention.
All future actual inputs still require separately qualified original leases/hashes; metadata declarations never substitute.

constants.current_runtime_reference: N4/file4096/capture16384/generation68/C92/E224 remains unchanged. Metadata analysis may report conditional numbers outside these bounds but issues no executable runtime admission.

deferred: All implementation until explicit root scope
Actual input roster, original access, source qualification, entry/FFI/physical output/resource/profile/native/science
detached_input: After initial check, perform bounded closed-shape/type/length capture into immutable tuples/proxies before subsequent check callbacks. No callbacks during this finite structural snapshot; reject list/key/string/integer bounds before copying/encoding. Semantic validation/arithmetic/encoding use only that snapshot. Callbacks may mutate caller originals later without changing this calculation. No concurrent-hostile-Python atomicity claim.

formulae.aggregate_only: If files=None and aggregate N_a,S_a known: if S_a=0, Rrange=[0,0], Crange=[6N_a,6N_a]; if S_a>0 require N_a>0, Pmax=min(N_a,S_a), Qmin=ceil(S_a/65536), Rrange=[Qmin+16,floor((S_a-Pmax)/65536)+17Pmax], Crange=Rrange+6N_a. For213/9017363392: R[137611,141215], C[138889,142493]. All exact per-file/role terms remain None.
formulae.capture: S_cap=sum sizes of captured_software+captured_metadata; S_bulk=sum hash_only_bulk sizes.
formulae.exact_vector: N=len(files), total_bytes=sum(size), positive_files=P=count(size>0), B=len(early_ids), M=len(modules). B/M remain None until their declarations bind to known vector.
formulae.logical: logical_call_bytes=C*call_record_bytes (full retained records, no tail dropping); index_bytes=N*file_index_bytes+M*module_index_bytes; hash_state_bytes=N*hash_state_bytes coefficient (conservative retained state per file).
formulae.memory: peak_declared_memory_bytes=raw_payload_bytes+immutable_capture_bytes+transient_bytes+logical_call_bytes+index_bytes+hash_state_bytes+2J+5Pkt+report_copies*V. 2J counts retained rows and join workspace; five packet buffers counted once; report copies include their output byte buffer, so do not add V again. transient_bytes excludes all these named buffers and must cover other declared copy/encoding workspace. This is logical payload only, never RSS.
formulae.output: J=1024E retained serialized journal rows. journal_bytes=J; packet_bound_bytes=Pkt; output_reserved_bytes=J+5Pkt+V. All five packet kinds share this conservative bound. V is one prospective full canonical report; its physical transport/universe is unselected, not a new current runtime output kind.
formulae.overflow: Every sum/product must be checked against2^63-1 before size-based allocation/encoding. Overflow refuses; no float coercion. Calculator allocates at most metadata-sized arrays, never C call records or derived byte pools.
formulae.packet: For canonical ordinal i=0..N-1 (NOT metadata ID), closures=[{file_id:i,invoked:false,return_observed:false,success:false}]; all false is the longest bool sizing state, not a valid complete observation union. Digests=[{file_id:i,size:declared_size,sha256:declared_sha256}]. closure_array_bound_bytes and digest_array_bytes are exact canonical JSON lengths of those arrays with no LF. Pkt=packet_overhead_bytes+both lengths. Overhead is a declared unselected bound for all other current-shaped packet fields/links; no producer/layout proof.
formulae.reads: Q=sum((size+65535)//65536); R=Q+16P; C=6N+R; E=6N+2B+2M+192. Exact terms require their inputs; never infer missing file/role/graph vectors from aggregate.
formulae.report: V=report_base_bytes+C*report_call_bytes+N*report_file_bytes+E*report_event_bytes; canonical_report_bytes=V. These are declared serialization/payload bounds, not actual report observations.

precode: Grammar freezes <=30 explicit metadata-only vectors/test module before implementation, including discriminating mixed-role equality and12 isolated cap-1 clones. Native independently reviews schema/arithmetic/unknown/refusal/immutability/callback boundaries. No streaming/runtime histories.

request.aggregate: exact {files,bytes}, each None or exact integer; files0..256, bytes0..2^63-1. Optional hints when vector supplied: any nonnull mismatch refuses; nulls do not cause unknowns then. With files=None, hints support only aggregate ranges, never per-file terms/positive envelope.
request.early_ids: None or exact unique list of metadata IDs; when vector known its set equals captured_software IDs; order retained

file.id: exact nonbool int0..N-1; unique permutation, not required to equal list position
file.path: exact str; char length<=4096 before strict UTF16 encoding;1..4096 UTF16 units; scalar text; same existing C/D DOS absolute lexical policy, slash mapping+ASCII case only; no UNC/device-prefix/relative/dot/trailing-dotspace/illegal/control/device-stem aliases. No E: widening, filesystem lookup, Unicode normalization or authenticity claim.
file.sha256: exact lowercase64 ASCII hex; syntax/metadata only, no source hash checked

request.files: None (unknown vector) or exact list0..256 of exact {id,path,role,size,sha256}

limits.domain: Every field is None or exact nonbool integer0..2^63-1; max_files additionally<=256. These are declared arithmetic limits, not active runtime caps.

module.dependencies: exact list0..256 of unique declared module names; closed and acyclic; package parents of dotted names must be declared package=True
module.file_id: metadata ID; exactly one module per captured_software file, no captured_metadata/bulk module
module.name: unique ASCII dotted Python identifier,1..128 chars, case-sensitive
module.package: exact bool; declared graph only, actual source imports not inspected

representation.domain: Every field is None or exact strictly-positive nonbool integer1..2^31-1; report_copies1..8. Zero coefficients refuse, including required record/state/report/overhead terms. Multiplication by absent structure count may naturally yield0.
representation.units: Declared logical payload upper terms only. No measured Python/native RSS/layout/timing claim, and no proven producer representation is inferred. Unknown coefficients prevent WITHIN status.

derived.domains: First5 are constants. Others int|None except aggregate ranges [int,int]|None. With files=None exact N/total/P/B/M/Q/R/C/E and role-dependent terms stay None; no positive status. With known vector, absent optional aggregate hints do not create unknowns.

result.encoding: UTF8 json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=True,allow_nan=False) with exactly one LF. Report bytes precomputed during calculation, immutable; to_dict returns detached containers. Check callback exceptions are never translated into data refusal.
result.precedence: Malformed/schema/domain/graph/aggregate mismatch first; else any known cap exceedance, even with other unknowns; else any unknown; else WITHIN_DECLARED_BOUNDS_ONLY. No status is runtime permission.
result.unknowns: Sorted unique strings: files,early_ids,modules; every null limits.KEY/representation.KEY; aggregate.files/aggregate.bytes only when files=None and those hints are null. Other dependency unknowns are represented by the missing source field, not fabricated0.

violations.file_id: canonical list ordinal for per-role cap violations, else None
violations.order: Stable sort by code then file_id(None=-1); all known cap violations retained. Invalid metadata returns one deterministic earliest schema/domain validation violation; derived constants retained, other derived fields None, unknowns[].
violations.required_and_limit: exact int|None; malformed refusals use None and do not echo unsafe values
